### Problem

The sync that keeps every repository in step writes broken workflows with template placeholders into repositories that never had them, so its pull requests cannot be merged and a maintainer has to sort each one by hand.

### Scope

`scripts/sync-repos.py callers` (and `check`, which reports a missing caller the same way): which callers it adds to a repository, and a guard against placeholders in what it writes, with its `--test`.

### Out of scope

The callers a repository already has, which the sync keeps updating as now. Opening the sync pull requests on its own from the daily drift check.

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given a repository whose repos.yml entry gives no slug and that is not published on wordpress.org, when `callers` runs for it, then it writes no `release-wp.yml`.
C2: Given any template file that would be written with a placeholder of its template (`my-plugin`, "Fill in"), when `callers` runs, then it writes none of it and names the repository and the missing value.
C3: Given a repository whose only drift is an old `issues.yml`, when `callers` runs, then the pull request changes `issues.yml` alone.

### Criticality

Normal
